title: Base Workspace
description: This workspace template is the foundation for TRE workspaces.

shared_storage_quota.title: Shared Storage Quota
shared_storage_quota.description: Quota (in GB) to set for the VM Shared Storage.

enable_airlock.title: Enable Airlock
enable_airlock.description: Allow safe import and export to the workspace

airlock_version.title: Airlock Version
airlock_version.description: Airlock storage version: 1 = legacy per-stage storage accounts, 2 = consolidated metadata-based storage. Leave unset to use the default (2). Version 1 requires legacy airlock to be enabled in core.

app_service_plan_sku.title: App Service Plan SKU
app_service_plan_sku.description: The SKU that will be used when deploying an Azure App Service Plan.

storage_account_redundancy.title: Storage Account Redundancy
storage_account_redundancy.description: The redundancy option for the storage account in the workspace: GRS (Geo-Redundant Storage) or ZRS (Zone-Redundant Storage).

address_space_size.title: Address space size
address_space_size.description: Network address size as a CIDR value or (small /24, medium /22, large /16 or custom with an IP range e.g. 10.2.1.0/25) to be used by the workspace.

address_spaces.title: Address spaces
address_spaces.description: Network address space to be used by the workspace.

enable_backup.title: Enable Backup
enable_backup.description: Enable backups for the workspace. Workspace services must support this feature.

vm_backup_policy.title: VM backup policy
vm_backup_policy.description: Overrides for the workspace VM daily backup policy. Omitted settings retain their existing defaults.

timezone.title: Azure timezone
timezone.description: Azure timezone name, for example UTC or GMT Standard Time.

time.title: Daily backup time
time.description: 24-hour time on the hour or half-hour in the selected timezone.

weekly_count.title: Weekly retention count (0 disables weekly retention)

monthly_count.title: Monthly retention count (0 disables monthly retention)

yearly_count.title: Yearly retention count (0 disables yearly retention)

fileshare_backup_policy.title: File-share backup policy
fileshare_backup_policy.description: Overrides for the workspace shared file-share daily backup policy. Omitted settings retain their existing defaults.

timezone.title: Azure timezone
timezone.description: Azure timezone name, for example UTC or GMT Standard Time.

time.title: Daily backup time
time.description: 24-hour time on the hour or half-hour in the selected timezone.

weekly_count.title: Weekly retention count (0 disables weekly retention)

monthly_count.title: Monthly retention count (0 disables monthly retention)

yearly_count.title: Yearly retention count (0 disables yearly retention)

enable_dns_policy.title: Enable DNS Security Policy
enable_dns_policy.description: Enable DNS Security Policy for the workspace.

deploy_to_another_subscription.title: Deploy workspace to another subscription
deploy_to_another_subscription.description: Check this box if you want to deploy the workspace to another subscription.

delete_backups_on_uninstall.title: Delete Backups on Deletion
delete_backups_on_uninstall.description: When the workspace is deleted, also delete its backups: the backup containers are unregistered and the Recovery Services Vault (with its recovery points) is deleted. When unchecked, protection is stopped but the vault and its resource group are retained so the backed up data is kept.

configure_review_vms.title: Configure Review VMs
configure_review_vms.description: Allow TRE to automatically create and delete review VMs for airlock approvals

airlock_review_config.title: Airlock Review Config
airlock_review_config.description: Configuration for Airlock Review feature. Needs to be set up after workspace creation

import_vm_workspace_service_id.title: Import Review Workspace Service ID
import_vm_workspace_service_id.description: ID for Workspace Service ID where to deploy Review user resources

import_vm_user_resource_template_name.title: Import Review VM User Resource Template Name
import_vm_user_resource_template_name.description: Template Name for User Resource for reviewing Import Requests

export_vm_workspace_service_id.title: Export Review Workspace Service ID
export_vm_workspace_service_id.description: ID for Workspace Service ID where to deploy Review user resources

export_vm_user_resource_template_name.title: Export Review VM User Resource Template Name
export_vm_user_resource_template_name.description: Template Name for User Resource for reviewing Export Requests

address_space.title: Address space
address_space.description: Network address space to be used by the workspace if 'Address space size' is custom.

client_id.title: Application (Client) ID
client_id.description: The AAD Application Registration ID for the workspace.

client_secret.title: Application (Client) Secret
client_secret.description: The AAD Application Registration secret for the workspace. This value will be stored in the Workspace Key Vault.

create_aad_groups.title: Create AAD Groups for each workspace role (Required for user management)
create_aad_groups.description: Create AAD Groups for the workspace roles. If this is set to true, the workspace will create new AAD Groups.

aad_redirect_uris.title: AAD Redirect URIs
aad_redirect_uris.description: Redirect URIs for the AAD app in Automatic Auth mode

workspace_subscription_id.title: Workspace Subscription ID
workspace_subscription_id.description: The subscription ID where the workspace will be deployed.
